title: Sound 2

components.label: a)
components.name: Sound 2 - Concepts and techniques in interactive and immersive audio design

learning_outcomes_intro: After successfully completing the module, students will be able to

items: outline principles of auditory perception as well as concepts and techniques of interactive audio.
understand principles of auditory perception as well as concepts and techniques of interactive audio.
apply the learned theoretical background, concepts and techniques of designing interactive audio.
identify essential elements and relationships in the composition of complex real and virtual audio environments.
create complex interactive and immersive audio environments.
critically discuss the design of interactive and immersive audio environments.
Principles of acoustics, room acoustics and psychoacoustics
Advanced listening and analysis of real and virtual sound environments
Concepts, techniques and tools for the design of virtual and augmented acoustic environments
Concepts, techniques and tools for interactive sound and music
